verdict.rationale: Recurring job or workflow scheduling is a fair question for an ATS with automation features, so the axis applies. The pack shows no recurring or cron-style scheduling. Webhooks fire on events rather than on a schedule, "Schedule events and sync your work calendar" covers calendar meetings, and "AI & Automation" is only a bare feature heading with no detail on scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
